settings.seed_order: ascending ID; port0 then port1; round-robin
settings.scientific_stop: 64 NEW attempts/arm;8 NEW accepts/seed; capacity or deadline; no seed replacement
settings.outward_qualification_scope: overlap donor tail OR aggregate endpoint relay, starting positive halfspace
settings.endpoint_tangent_source: unit003 source axial port for outward evidence; registration uses local directed finite-curve tangents
settings.whole_path_geometry: unit004 validate on final Q for both relation types
settings.history_geometry: pre-update current outward Q versus relay Q/first gap or overlap tail/gap0
settings.endpoint_angle_guards: apply only to endpoint relay hops; overlap registration unchanged
settings.seed_evidence: M5 saved endpoint-merge provenance and two substantial M4 support contributions; not physical truth
settings.initialization_membership_invariant: all fields exact against saved unit005 BASE_FINAL; no growth is inferred from extra seed metadata

observation_policy.support_bounds: union of saved intervals in original finite q; EPS-only clamping
observation_policy.geometry: interpolate support bounds; retain every interior original knot; no fit/extrapolation/member removal
observation_policy.member_revalidation: all original rows against q_obs using unchanged residual/tangent gates
observation_policy.tensor_weights: equal total weight per occupied bin
observation_policy.sign: align principal axis with q_obs outward segment; abs dot<=EPS UNKNOWN
observation_policy.query_and_oracle_port_policy: endpoint hops use current/source and donor observed axes; overlap uses unchanged registration guards
observation_policy.unknown_port: cannot gain a link; background memberships unchanged
observation_policy.purpose: exact replay of saved observation bank and composite axial ports; derivative invalidity remains UNKNOWN

historical_relay_policy.overflow: whole frontier NOT_RUN; no truncated promotion
historical_relay_policy.enumeration: canonical carrier/port DFS; locally valid nonempty prefixes
historical_relay_policy.minimality: first support AND whole-path-valid prefix; failed shorter prefixes remain expandable
historical_relay_policy.qualification_scope: all new relay leaves; start-frontier positive halfspace
historical_relay_policy.ambiguity: first two common relays within 0.15p first-gap; before history including shared-first-donor branches
historical_relay_policy.history_input: current outward seed chain and complete oriented relay; unchanged unit001 history

overlap.projection_ties: original lowest finite-segment ID before reversing
overlap.registration_samples: both boundaries + every mapped A/B knot + uniform spacing <=1p
overlap.blend: linear weight u/w, A(LA-w+u) to B(s-w+u); retain A prefix and B suffix
overlap.branch_knots: union of all original leaf knots and new auxiliary knots
overlap.support_mapping: all original interval endpoints to Q; record extended_s/clamp; union once

overlap.history_tail: oriented B from attachment s to LB

overlap.overflow: entire frontier NOT_RUN; complete query/proposal list retained

switch.seed_curve: current saved auxiliary q, never reconstructed from original leaves
switch.relation_scope: single overlap OR endpoint-only minimal relay per transaction; switching between transactions
switch.combined_count: all overlap orientations plus locally hop-qualified endpoint prefixes;257 aborts whole frontier
switch.short_prefix_failures: expand through at most3 donors; first support+whole-geometry valid prefix terminates branch
